cv_text: tkvwalawitsolhenho anikwalihsi ale khilo iyunhski tinwelihski tsiluhslmi ntayunilohsvhi
anikwalihsiyhenho ale nani'vkwo anitsuhsi iyunho ohstv nitunahsulehvna yiki vlha ynalhstayvhvhsko'i tanikhanhwateko nuniwehsv ethi unatenhvhi
nhkwonho anikwalihsi ale tinowhelihski ikvwahthvtvnhe hi'a nikwawehsele'i katono ketshstawatitohi vlha ytnikhanhawateka ethi unatenhvhi uninhetsvi nahski nitunahsulehvnakwo tsanalhstayvhvhska

tunhetshelvnho hi'a nituwehsele'i ihsay yelikwo nuwehsv utolehohsv nihi itsatlonahsti itsinhe'ihstihskvi hi'a tsinikvnhv tsikowhela hi'a nahski yvwi kvkilvkwohtiha tunihanekalv tanhvhtiha tsuninawihskini invhiyu nitunvnhateka ayv nakwatvnhvi
ahsenho ahsekwokwo kvkilvkwohtiha tsitanateyohvhska tanateyhohvhskv yvwikwo uninhetsvhi
ale hi'a nituwehsele'i ohsikwo nitsatvneha tsitsiyo'ihseha unelhanvhi unhetsv nahski itsatseli tikhanhawatvhsti itsihskwanikotohtiyi
nahski unelhanvhi utseli khanohetv ahsekwo nitsvneho itstihsko nihi itsinetsvi ale utsathi iyutaleki nahski iyuhstitani nitsatvneho'i
nikatvnho yvwi wituyhanvhv hi'a nituwehsele'i skiyathvtahstahsi nitsi'vi ale itsolhihki
khilo tekalilhuhkehsti uthvkotiyi nahski wathvkvka
kalitsotenho wuyvlhv tutanvelv yvwi kvwhstawatitohi kvwahttvnhe talhilohstv ukvwal
nahski unawiyi wnayvhihvna kehsv iyuhsti uhskwolhiyikwohskini ale wikalohihstihskvkwo nahskino kanvkalihskv nika'v alhstayvhti
hi'ano nuwehse'i nahski na yvwihi unukotsvhi nahski kataha nuwaneho yvwi
hawiniyhenho nvtayutalenhvhi yvwi unawhiyi titalehvhska uyo atanvthehti kehsvi atayhonehti kehsvi utelitv tinhsihti kehsvi atahihsti kehsvi
kanohskitv kehsvi tsukvwahlti akhvhihsti kehsvi uyo iyatvnehti kehsvi kalonuhetv kehsvi alhsotlvihstohti kehsvi atvyhukehti kehsvi atahsotlvihstohtiyi atlvkwohtohtiyi alhskanhwhsti kehsvi
nanhanho tulenhv thaya ale satoni ahstv wuluhtse'i ale atanelv wuylhv vlha yutulihske khilo utolehohihstiyi ahsenho vlha kvwatihskalohti ykehse'i
khiloyhenho iyuhsti akeyhv nahski uwetsi athvnutsa kataha atanto uya'i uthvkanv atsinohehskvi uluhtse ale tulahskv utanvne'i
nahskinho unhetse hi'a nuwehsele'i utohiyuhi tsakvwiyuhi ahsenho kilhi kahskilv hawinitilv tiniyolhi uninko'ahihselvhi katu analhstayvhtihsko'i
nahskino tsuwenvhsv wi'uluhtsv utolehohse ahskina unukotsvi uwetsinho atsehstokihi kanvhkvi
ale thaline thaya ale satoni ahstv unhikihsv kelili vtal wuluhtse'i ayelhi ulohse ahskohitikatukiyi skatuki kehsvi
ikwahthinhelenho khilo tsuli'ena ale kanila kawonihski ale ikvwhstiyethane nahski uhsihthatihstiyi
sunale'iyunho ikvyiyi ika sunatotakwahsti kehsvi uniluhtse atselihstv tsvtikhalkokwo
wtunakhanhannho unikohe nvya ahvtv kehsi utsathiyenho ekwohiyu kehse'i
ulhihstinho uninukotsv tunalithehse atselihstvi tuninawihskeyhenho ale unihskwanikohske'i vlha ale khilo kohuhsti ynohsele'i anihska'iheyhenho
tsihsano tulehihsanhv sunale'iyu ikvyyi ika sunatotkwahsti kehsvi ikvyi kvnkehsv nutvnhele meli makiteli ehi nahski kalhihkwoki anihskina tsitunukowhsele'i
nahskino uwenv unetolhi wtunonhele uyo tunatanvhtvi ale tanaloyhvi
nahskino unathvkanv kvnhvi ale nahski ukohvi vlha yunohiyunhe'i
nahskinho unenv wituninhonele anihso'i nahskwo vlha yitunohiyunhe nahski
kilo kohiyuhvhskehsti ale akawohskehsti atsihstelhvhti kehsehsti nikohiyuhvhskvnahskini tsakukotanehti kehsehsti
hi'ano nahski uyelhvhtv tikolhihstohti thali tutvhtitekehsti anohiyuhvhski ayv takwato'v anvhtihskehsti anihskina taninukowhihskehsti nwanatale tsuniwonihihsti taniwonihskehsti
nahskino ukvwiyuhi tuwonhehthanv kalvlati totsattanilvtse'i ale akhathihsi itilv unelhanvhi uwolhv uwenhe'i
tsihsanho utenhv katuy katuhv tsutiyi nahiyu tsehe elotv ukvwiyuhi kvnhiyukwo uniluhtse tsiluhsilmi anikhahthanha'i nvto tikhalvkv ititlv tsunilohse'i
hi'a nuniwehse'i hatlv na tsutenhv ukvwiyuhi anitsuhsi unatselika okikohvyhenho utseli nokwihsi tikhalvkv itilv ale otsatatolihstanelika
elotvnho ukvwiyuhi uthvkan nahski uwelihihsti utanvtate'i ale nikatv tsiluhslmi anehi
tulawitvnho nikatv nunikvwiyuhsv atsilv anelhohi ale yvwi tinowhelanehi tuthvtvnhe'i nanha utehti kehsv kalonetv
hi'ano nikvwawehseli tsutiyi katuyi katuhvi hi'ayhenho nuwanhv uwowhela atolehohski
ale nihi katuyi katuhv tsutiyi vtlhahskini tsahstikhani yiki tsiltahsuya nunikvwiyuhsv tsutiyi nihiyhenho tatsanukotsi tikwtseli yvwi ihsilitikhanetsehi
ale tunvhse katuyi hi'a nuwehse'i itsena ohstv wetsiyoka nahski uhsti ayolhi iyunho etsiwahthvha ihskinonhelilha ayvno nahskwo wtsiluhtsvha ale tsiyatatolihstanelvha
unikohvnho nahski nokwhsi ulthanvhi unalihelitse'i
nhakwonho tulenhv uthinhvhse ayolhi ale utsi svnoyi ale itsityi wlohse'i
lemayi khanekv unathvkanvki taniyvhkvi ale tanatloyihvi ale utsathi unelhuhkvi letsili tahskonhihv tsuwetsi ale nutulihskvna kehsv unuwohihstiyi ntklhstohtihskv nanehvnakwo kehsvi
hi'a nuwehsele'i thalehvka ale hathinhuka ayolhi ale utsi ale hena ihsliyi nhakwoyhenho tuniyohuhsv ayolhi kvnhv tsuniyhohvki
tulenhvnho uthinhvhse ayolhi ale utsi ale ihsiliyi wuluhtse'i
tsiyuhinho utsanv tuwehsohtse'i uwahsvnho uwetuhv wuluhtse'i
kvniykwonho ikatv tnowelihski hi'a nuniwehse tunatanhvhthvi hi'a ahskaya kalvlati ehi ahsotlvihstiha
tsihsanho akahthahe nuhstv anatanthehskvi hi'anho nituwehsele'i katonho uyo itsatanhvhtheha titsinawiyi
tulenhvnho tsuwenvhsv wulohse'i
unitsathinho unikohv unihskwanikohse'i ale unilvkwohthane unelhanvhi nahski tsulhskoltanelvhi nahski iyuhsti tsunilvwhstantiyi yvwi
hi'ano nulhsthanvki kankv alhstayvhvhskv kaltsote kvniyukwo unitsathvki atelv anikihsitohi ale anihskana uniluhtsv unantlnvki aninvtlha'v tsihsa ale kvwhstawatitohi
anikwalihsinho unatolehohsv hi'a nitu niwehsel kvwhstawatitohi katonho titseyhohvhski atelv anikihsitohi ale anihskana itsulaha i'analhstayvhvhska
tsihsanho uthvkanv hi'a nituwehselvki nitunitlvkvna vlha utulhvhti yinunalhstanheho titanhvwihski tsunilvkihskini

tsihsanho hi'a nituwehselvki tsiko yeli tekekatsvhstihskv anikhahthahi yitanatloyka ahsikwo utehsvnhilhvhi unelatitohvi ahsenho ika tvlhiyilolhi taketsiyanhveli utehsvnhilhvhi khila nhakwo amalhi tnvnhi

vlha ale itse kikake'atithahsti tsuwethi tihsulvht ytanilihstihsko'i tihsulvhtyhenho ytatatsakalv ale kikake'atithahsti yatsewoki tihsulvhtnho yitayoki itsehskini kikake'atithahsti titse tihsutlvht tanitlihstihsko'i itsulnho tunihskwanikoto'i
tsihsanho tulenhv uhstawatvhsvki al nahskwo kvwhstawatitohi
hi'ayhenho nuwehse utanvhthvi iyunho unhuwa'vkwo yakwahsvnhilv ahse yakwatiwhi
hi'a ntuwehselvki itsatanvn nahknho uyohuhsvhi yiki akeyhutsa kalhihakwohskini vkvwyetshsthanvkwonho
ketsinukowhsvnho yvwi uyvlhvki uwoyeni uniyvhvki akeyhutsanho tulenhvki
nahskinho hi'a tunotsalhohtsitolvi nnha nikvnatv tuyelihsitolvki
nhkwonho tuhsvnhelv tinikhahtholi hi'a nuwehsvki nuhstv ihstohiyuhvhskv nahskiya nihstalihstahsi
tinikhahtholinho tulhstukhsvki tsihsanho tunvhstatelvki hi'a ntuwehselvki lhehsti khilo utolehohsvki
ahsenho unatanvhskwo tuninotsalhanvki nanha nikvnathvi
ahskinnho atsinukowhsv uwakhewi uwonihsvki unitsathinho unihskwanikohsvki hi'a nuniwehsvki vlha ilvhiyu nahski iyuhsti akohvhi yiki ihsiliyi
ahsenho anikwalihsi hi'a nuniwehsvki anihskina unatseli ukvwiyuhi kvhtiha tsitekanukowhihska anihskina

tsihsanho nika'v tsuthvna tekatuhv ale tshsti tekatuhv uwetolvki tateyhohvhskvki tsunilawihstiyi ale alihtsitohvhskvki ohstv khanohetv kalvlati ehi ukvwiyuhi kehsv khanohehskvki ale tkhanvwihskv nika'v tunitlvkv ale nika'v vyuki yvwi uniyhilitehvi
tukohvnho unitsathi yvwi tuwetolitsvki uhtahkalhstohtihskvki wanakwo tnilokvi ale unatikaleyotsvhi kehsvi nahskiya awhi uninotena nehvna tsikehso unikhahthiya
nahski iyuhsti etsithayohsi uloketv tsunvhstiyi tsunilvwhstanehi ukathvnatselvi
kalvlatiyhenho utselikohi nahskiyakwo ahskaya kanela snaliyu tsuwenvhse tsitunvhsvhse kohuhsti anatvnehi thelvlati tuwhsv tsunilvwhstantiyi
nhakwonho nahski ahskaya kohuhsti anatvnehi tunukhohthanv akihsi tsukvwalhohti tskyvehtiy sika thelvlati totsuwhsv tunvhse'i
ale hi'a nituwehseli itsenha nahskwo nihi thelvlati totiwihsvi tuyukhohthvnho kehsv tatsvyakuyveli unenvhsenho
thaline ika i'uwenvhse ale nahskwo tso'ine iyulhilotv khalawatihsv uhsvhiyeyi nahskiya ni'utvnele'i
hihskinenho iyulhilotv khalawatihsv thaline i'uwenvhse'i ale tuwhahthvhe nvwanatale anitona'e kohuhsti nanatvnehvna hi'ano nituwehseli katonho ani itsitona'a utotakwatv kohuhsti nitsatvnehvna
layhenha khilo yokinvhsv unatvnhe'i hi'ano nituwehseli nihi nahskwo itsena thelvlati totiwhsvi tuyukhohthvnho kehsv tatsvyakuyveli
hihskinnho iyulhilotv khalawatihsv ketsinvhsvhi uniluhtsv anihsiywha akihsi tsukvwalhohti kekakyvele'i
kkkyvelvnho uniknlohihselekwo ahskaya kanela
hi'a nuniwehse'i hi'a onhiyi uniluhtsvhi sakwokwo iyulhilotv tunilvwhstahsi itsulahakwonho nhskiyvka ayv nahski kakehsv ale utilhekv ika tsokilvwhstanelvhi
ahsenho ahsiyvwi unhetsele hi'a nuwehsele'i kinali'i vlha utsathini ynikvyvneha lahsko ohsi yitsayelvnhe akihsi tsukvwalohti kvyakyvehtiyi
hiki tsatselika ale tsihena ohsi akiyelv tsiyakyvehtiyi hi'a onhiyi uluhtsvhi nihi kvykyvelv ika'i
howanho onhiyi tsiki ikvyi kehsehsti ikvyinho tsiki onhiyi kehsehsti unitsahthayhenho ketsiyanvhv ahsenho anikayolhiyu kekahsuyehsv
tsihsanho tsiluhslmi wakahthvi thalatu iyanitv anatahstawatitohi unnelki iyvtv wituthinhvhsthanvki ale hi'a nituwehselvki
hi'ano nuwehselvki kato tsatuliha hi'a nvtayuwehselvki halhskolhvta hi'a anithali tikwetsi tsunihtiyi tsatselikohi kehsvi sakwo hikhahthihsi itilv so'ino hikhskani
ahskohinho iynitv unathvkanv utsathi unithlhawohsvki tuninikwathilv anithali tinatanhvlhi
tsihsanho wtuyhanvhv hi'a nuwehsvki itsikhahthaha ayelhi tekolhvwatihsv nunikvwiyuhsateki aninheko iyunatvnelitahstiyi yvwi ale ketsilvkwoti aninhetsitohv nanatvneho'i
nihihskini lhehsti nahski yinitsvhnehsti khilohskini atsilvkwoti iylhstohtiyi utulihskehsti nahski etsinvhsitahsti kehsehsti
ale khilo ukvwiyuhi iyulhstohtiyi utulihskehsti nahski etsinalha'i kehsehsti
tselikonho unnhikihsv unitsathi yvwi kvwhstawatvhsvki
khvnhiykwonho anithal tinikhewi unohulhohti tunolhvki unahthvkannho tsihsa ulohsvi unelhunhvki hi'a nuniwehski skinitoliki tsakvwiyuhi tewi uwetsi
unatotakwonhvhinho khila ika nikalhstihske'i alenihskv suntotakwahsti kehsv meli makiteli ehi ale so'i meli unakahthanhilhe atselihstvi
ale kvnhiyukwo utsathi katohi ulihthelvnhe'i yihowayhenho utseli tikhanhawatitohi kalvlati tsulo'ahse'i uluhtsvnho nvya uwehsakwalelhe uhvhse kalohihstiyi ahvi ale uhskilhane'i
anikhahthiyanho anihska'ihv tuninawe'i ale tsuniyohuhsvhi nahskiya nunalhsthane'i
tikhanhawatitohinho unhetsv hi'a nituwehsele anikeyhv lhehsti nihi yihstihska'ihehsti tsikahthhayhenho tsihsa akatvnvhi ehstiyohvi
ale ulhihstiyu ihstena witihstinhohvhsi kvwhstawatitohi te'ulenhv uyohuhsvi ale kvnhiyukwo ikvyi kelili ntayehsi nanha tayetsiko'i khvnhiyukwo ihstvnohvhsi
ulhihstiyunho atselihstv unatanvhse'i anihska'ihe ale utsathi analihelike'i ale tunihskwalvhthane kvwahstawatitohi tuninonelvhse'i
ana'ihsvnho taninhonelihsv kvwahstawatitohi khvnhiyukwo tsihsa tunatlohse'i tohiyi tetatakowhahthv utvnhe'i uniluhtsvnho tsulahsihteni tuniniyvhe'i elati nikvwatvnhele'i
ana'ihsvnho khvniyukwo ikatv uniyawihsvhi uniluhtse katuhvi ale nunikvwiyuhsv atsilvanelhi tuninhonhele nikatv nulhsthanitolvi
hi'a nuniwehse'i hi'a nitsiwehsvha kvwhstawatitohi svnoyi uniluhtsvki otsilhinv kvwanohskihsvki
iyunho nahski athvkanv ukvwiyuhi tayotsihstiyethani ale tatsvhstelvhi
tunikihsvnho atelv niketsiwehselv nunatvnele'i nahskinho hi'a khanohetv ahsi aninhelhitoha anitsuhsi
nhkwonho satu iyanitv kvwhstawatitohi kelili unenvhsvki tsotalv tsihsa unahsehelvi
kvwakohvnho elati nikvwatvnhelvki ahsenho ikatv unatlahsithvelvkwo
tsihsanho uluhtsv tuwonhehthanvki hi'a nuwehsvki vkhinelv nika'v tiklwhstanehtiy kalvlati ale elohi
